column1: # How disk cleanup recognizes a running test process. Format: label<TAB>ERE.
# Each pattern is checked against one command line with a space appended, so a
# trailing [ ] means "end of word". Patterns start at the executable, so a shell
# or an agent whose arguments merely mention a test runner does not match; the real
# runner it starts does. Installing a runner is not running it. An executable path
# may hold spaces, so a later word may continue it, unless that word starts a new
# absolute path, a relative ./path, or an option. A command line cannot show where
# one argument ends, so these limits remain: a relative argument with no leading dot
# reads as a continued path and stands down, and a real path with a word that starts
# with a dash or a dot is missed. Vectors: test-lane-vectors.tsv.
